title: Circuit-Breakers: Acceptance Criteria for Agentic Systems // Risk Controls 03 #aiagents #aiadoption
description: Agentic systems are non-deterministic — you can't test your way to safety. Circuit-breakers are the acceptance criteria you derive from system stressors before the agent ever runs.
transcript: Agentic systems are non-deterministic — you can't test your way to safety. Circuit-breakers are the acceptance criteria you derive from system stressors before the agent ever runs.
